title: Ice Ether Mod
description: This Minecraft mod has added Ice Ether
body:
## What's This?
This is a mod related to the Ice Ether,Added some items and blocks.
## add Items
add red ice ether,blue ice ether
## add Blocks
add red ice ether block,blue ice ether block
## add food
add ice ether apple
## add armor
add Ice Ether Armor
Synthesize with Blue Ether Crystal！

This is synthetic formula:
